spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present continuous for a temporary situation?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] He is eating at the canteen this week because the kitchen is being repainted.
B. [WRONG] He eats lunch at noon every day. He has done so for years.
C. [WRONG] He ate at the canteen yesterday because he was too tired to cook.
D. [WRONG] He eats breakfast before he leaves for work.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: He eats lunch at noon every day. He has done so for years., He ate at the canteen yesterday because he was too tired to cook., He eats breakfast before he leaves for work.
